Which of the following is a subspace of $\mathbb{R}^2$?

A. $W=\{(x,y)\mid y=x\}$

B. $W=\{(x,y)\mid x,y>0\}$

C. $W=\{(x,y)\mid y-x=1\}$

D. $W=\{(x,y)\mid y<0\}$
